relationships.subject: anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: A significant decrease in mean monthly aura days was observed throughout the observation period

relationships.subject: anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: We observed a statistically significant decrease in mean monthly headache days as well

key_findings: In 14 patients, anti-CGRP mAbs reduced monthly aura days (13 to 1) and headache days (21 to 5) over 12 months with no adverse events.
